title: Lead Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a Lead SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test ) to provide end-to-end technical governance across all QA layers — frontend, middleware, and backend — for a complex, multi-layered onboarding platform. This role owns the architecture of API contract testing and the data modeling of complex entity relationships (e.g., hierarchical/parent-child style structures), while ensuring that quality assumptions made at one layer (such as client-side validation) are independently verified at every downstream layer rather than trusted at face value. The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership with the ability to set and enforce delivery governance across cross-functional teams.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provide technical governance across frontend, middleware, and backend testing layers.
* Establish and enforce QA delivery standards, evidence requirements, review processes, and quality gates.
* Review frontend constraint dictionaries and FSM/state-model outputs for completeness and consistency.
* Review API schema reconstructions, network evidence, and tracer replay outputs for technical quality and traceability.
* Coordinate with QA Analysts, SDETs, and Test Operations Associates to align technical execution with delivery timelines.
* Review test architecture decisions, validation approaches, and coverage strategies.
* Coordinate dependency resolution, evidence rework, and cross-layer reconciliation throughout the engagement.
* Act as the escalation point for cross-layer technical discrepancies and evidence-quality issues.
* Compile and quality-check the raw technical evidence dossiers produced by the workstreams.
* Identify evidence gaps, inconsistencies, or areas requiring rework before handoff to client stakeholders.
* Report on delivery health, technical risks, evidence quality, dependencies, and unresolved gaps.
* Prepare the technical evidence package for handoff to the client team responsible for final modelling and logic-gap assessment.
* Support technical readout preparation by ensuring that findings are traceable to empirical evidence.

**Project Details**

**Title**: Lead SDET **Rate:** $17/hr  
**Start Date:** 19th October  
**Duration:** 4 Months  
**Commitment:** 22 Hours per Week  
**Location:** India (Remote)  
**Job Type:** Contractual (with the possibility of a Full-time employment extension based on performance and project needs)

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Proven experience of 8+ years in a QA leadership role spanning multiple testing layers (frontend, middleware, backend)
* Demonstrated expertise in API contract testing architecture and governance
* Practical experience with knowledge graph or entity-relationship data modeling and its application to test/data traceability
* Strong understanding of layered system architectures and the importance of independently verifying quality at each layer rather than relying on upstream assumptions
* Strong track record of technical delivery governance, including setting standards and quality gates
* Excellent cross-functional leadership and stakeholder communication skills
* Deep technical grounding across QA disciplines (manual, automation, systems-level testing) to credibly guide teams at every layer
* Experience mentoring or managing SDETs and QA Analysts
* Experience leading complex multi-week technical QA, API validation, or security-assessment engagements is strongly preferred.
* Experience establishing evidence/traceability models across complex technical workflows is preferred.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs, entity-relationship models, or structured technical dependency/evidence modeling is preferred; deep knowledge-graph engineering expertise is not required.
* Ability to synthesize technical evidence into concise stakeholder-ready findings and handoff materials.

title: Senior Cyber Security Engineer - Delhi
description:
**Job Description: Sr. Cyber Security Engineer**

**Job Title:** Senior Cyber Security Engineer

**Reporting To:** Head of IT

**Location:** Moti Nagar, New Delhi

**Experience Level:** 7–8 Years

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Purpose**

We are looking for a hands-on **Senior Cyber Security Engineer** with 7 to 8 years of dedicated experience to manage and strengthen our enterprise security operations and defence architecture. Reporting directly to the **Head of IT**, you will take end-to-end operational ownership of our cybersecurity stack—covering full-lifecycle management of EDR/XDR, DLP, Secure Web Gateway/Websense, Patching, and Network Security controls.

You will lead vulnerability assessments across our hybrid IT landscape, correlate cyber threat intelligence, investigate security alerts, and execute incident remediation across all endpoints, servers, and branch locations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Endpoint Detection & Incident Response (EDR / XDR)**

* Administer, tune, and manage the complete lifecycle of enterprise EDR solutions (e.g., SentinelOne, CrowdStrike Falcon, or Microsoft Defender for Endpoint).
* Investigate behavioural alerts, detect anomalous end-user behaviour, contain ransomware/malware outbreaks, and isolate compromised hosts.
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA), build automated remediation scripts, and maintain host-level hardening baselines.

**2. Data Loss Prevention (DLP) & Web Security**

* Own the deployment, policy tuning, and incident triage for enterprise **DLP** across endpoints, networks, and cloud/email channels to prevent unauthorized data exfiltration.
* Manage **Websense / Forcepoint Web Security (SWG)** or cloud proxy solutions: enforce URL filtering, SSL inspection, acceptable use policies, and defend against malicious web-borne traffic.
* Handle user violation escalations in coordination with internal IT, compliance, and management teams.

**3. Network & Infrastructure Defense**

* Manage perimeter and internal network security controls on Next-Generation Firewalls (Fortinet FortiGate, Palo Alto Networks, or Cisco Firepower/ASA).
* Monitor and tune IDS/IPS rules, inspect VPN connections (Site-to-Site and Remote Access), and verify strict network segmentation (VLANs/subnets) across head office and branch networks.
* Ensure secure communication channels and monitor encrypted egress/ingress traffic.

**4. Landscape Vulnerability Assessment & Patch Management**

* Execute recurring vulnerability scans across workstations, physical/virtual servers, network gear, and cloud environments using tools like Tenable Nessus, Qualys, or Rapid7.
* Prioritize Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) based on business impact and drive SLA-backed remediation.
* Oversee end-to-end automated OS and third-party software patch management cycles (via Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, or ManageEngine Endpoint Central).
* Track Zero-Day alerts and coordinate emergency out-of-band hotfix rollouts.

**5. Threat Intelligence & Landscape Monitoring**

* Ingest and operationalize cyber threat intelligence (CTI) from trusted feeds, ISACs, OSINT, and MITRE ATT&CK frameworks.
* Ingest Indicators of Compromise (IoCs) and Indicators of Attack (IoAs) into detection platforms to proactively block emerging campaign vectors.
* Review daily security dashboards and report operational security risk posture directly to the Head of IT.

**Technical Skills & Toolsets**

* **EDR / XDR:** SentinelOne, CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Carbon Black.
* **Data Loss Prevention (DLP):** Forcepoint DLP, Symantec DLP, Digital Guardian, or Microsoft Purview.
* **Web Gateway / Proxy:** Websense / Forcepoint Web Security, Zscaler (ZIA), Cisco Umbrella.
* **Vulnerability Management:** Tenable Nessus, Qualys VMDR, Rapid7 InsightVM.
* **Threat Intelligence & SIEM/Logging:** AlienVault OTX, VirusTotal Enterprise, MISP, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel.
* **Patch Management:** Microsoft Intune / SCCM, ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus / Endpoint Central.
* **Network Security:** Fortinet FortiGate, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco Firewalls/Routers/Switches.
* **Scripting & OS:** PowerShell, Bash, Python; deep familiarity with Windows Server, Active Directory, and Linux.

**Candidate Profile & Qualifications**

* **Education:** B.Tech / B.E. / MCA / B.Sc in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field.
* **Experience:** 7–8 years of direct, hands-on experience in enterprise cybersecurity operations, SOC engineering, or network security.
* **Mindset:** Strong troubleshooting ability under incident pressure, collaborative approach when working with IT infrastructure leads, and structured documentation skills.
* **Certifications (Preferred):**
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) or CompTIA Security+ / CySA+
* Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) / GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)
* Vendor certifications: Fortinet NSE 4+, SentinelOne Administrator, or Microsoft SC-200 / AZ-500

**Interested candidate can speak with Riya 8586913978 and share your resume at recruit5@thesachdevgroup.com.**

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

description:

You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. title: Senior Detection Engineer
description:
Talanos Cybersecurity delivers managed SOC, identity governance, third\-party risk management, dark web intelligence, continuous autonomous pentesting and security advisory services to mid\-market and regulated organisations across the UK, Europe, South Africa, Botswana and India. We are CREST SOC accredited and certified ISO 27001 and ISO 9001\.

We are building a dedicated Detection Engineering function and this is its founding role. We need someone who can engineer detections across enterprise SIEM platforms and who can also understand a customer's business well enough to know which detections actually matter to them. You will work across multiple SIEM platforms and sectors, with direct access to the CTO and real influence over our in\-house product roadmap.

**What you'll be doing**

* Baseline and improve detection coverage for assigned customers against MITRE ATT\&CK and their own risk profile
* Author, test, version and maintain detection content across multiple SIEM platforms
* Determine the log sources and telemetry needed for a given detection outcome and troubleshoot integrations, parsers and data quality
* Work directly with customers to translate their business risk into monitoring requirements a SOC analyst can act on
* Build the correlation layer that connects our security services to one another (e.g. turning dark web credential exposures into tuned identity detections)
* Track the threat landscape and build a reusable detection library so work for one customer raises the baseline for all

**What you'll need**

*You don't need to tick every box below, but most of these should describe you:*

* 6\+ years in cybersecurity, with real hands\-on experience in security operations, SIEM engineering or detection content
* Deep, practical experience with at least one enterprise SIEM (e.g. Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar, Elastic Security, Google SecOps, Sumo Logic) and confidence working across more than one
* Demonstrable experience authoring detection logic in a query language such as KQL, SPL, EQL, Lucene, YARA\-L or Sigma
* Strong working knowledge of MITRE ATT\&CK used for coverage and gap analysis, not just as a reporting label
* Practical understanding of log sources across Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, identity systems, network, email and EDR
* Ability to hold a credible conversation with a customer about their business and convert it into monitoring requirements
* Clear written and spoken English

**Nice to have**

* Python or PowerShell scripting; detection\-as\-code workflows using Git and CI pipelines
* Purple team experience, or use of Atomic Red Team, Caldera or a commercial breach and attack simulation platform
* Structured, hypothesis\-driven threat hunting experience
* Identity security experience (identity governance, privileged access, privileged account monitoring)
* Cloud or detection certifications (AZ\-500, SC\-200, AWS Security Specialty, GCDA, GCIA, GCFA, GCED, OSCP)

**What we offer**

* Genuine ownership of a new discipline, reporting directly to the CTO
* Breadth across multiple customers, sectors and SIEM platforms
* A funded training and certification budget
* Standard business hours, no shift work and no on\-call rota (with regular calls overlapping into the UK afternoon/evening, roughly 1:30pm\-9:30pm IST)
* A clear path to leading the function as it grows

To apply, please submit your CV along with a short note on one detection you personally designed and built: what it was for, what evidence it relied on, and how you knew it worked.

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹250,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Describe a detection you personally designed and built. What was it for, what evidence did it rely on, how did you confirm it worked?
* Which SIEM platform(s) have you personally authored detection content in (not just administered), and which query language(s) have you used (e.g. KQL, SPL, Sigma)?
* How many years of hands\-on experience do you have specifically authoring or maintaining detection logic, as distinct from monitoring or triaging alerts?
* Give an example of a time you explained a security risk or detection gap to a non\-technical stakeholder or customer. What was the situation and how did you approach it?
* This role involves occasional travel to Delhi (roughly once a month) and regular working hours that overlap into the UK afternoon/evening (approx. 1:30pm\-9:30pm IST). Are you comfortable with this?
* What is your current notice period?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Delhi, Delhi

title: Analyst, Financial Instruments and Technology
description:
As a market leader in providing illiquid portfolio analysis, our Alternative Asset Management professionals assist clients in the valuation of alternative investments, specifically for securities and positions for which there are no active market quotations available. Our professionals have the opportunity to work on a wide range of projects with exposure to the bespoke investment structures and asset classes of our institutional investor clientele.


Kroll's **Financial Instruments and Technology (complex securities valuation)** practice is a leading solutions provider for asset managers, hedge funds, fund administrators, banks, insurers, private equity firms, commodity trading and investment firms, and corporations. We are looking for Analyst’s who will be involved in providing support to our global valuation practice.


**Day\-to\-day responsibilities:**

The Analyst will assist on a range of valuation advisory services to the alternative asset community and gain exposure to exciting the esoteric nature of such positions. Responsibilities include:


* Developing deep technical strength in the valuation of alternative assets, through direct exposure to high\-profile clients and alternative asset industry professionals
* Reviewing investment memoranda, governing documents of structured investments, board of directors’ presentations, and client models
* Assisting the team with interviewing clients, including preparing information request lists, participating in face\-to\-face meetings, to gather data and information pertinent to the engagement
* Assisting in the design of financial models for discounted cash flow, market multiple, market transaction and option pricing analyses
* Performing valuation analysis on a wide range of illiquid investments broadly distributed across industries and geographies while using accepted and relevant approaches and theory
* Compiling statistical summaries of companies’ financial information, developing and computing financial ratios, and presenting the analyses in an organized manner and/or using our standard formats and presentations
* Working with management to build, develop, and maintain client relationships
* Reporting and presenting analyses and conclusions including written reports, including assisting in the presentation of work products and conclusions internally to clients
* Attending relevant industry events to broaden your knowledge and experience within the alternative asset community

**Essential traits:**

* CA, Master's degree in Finance, Accounting or Economics or equivalent thereof (e.g., CFA); or MBA from an accredited college/university
* Minimum 0\-1 year of experience constructing and reviewing valuation models and other financial models including: enterprise valuation using DCF \& market approaches, and other structured investment models
* Experience with credit analysis or structured securities experience is a plus: CLOs, CMBS, RMBS, ABS, etc., Intex or other tools
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, as well as strong verbal and written communication skills
* A fundamental understanding of financial valuation theory, methodologies, and applications
* Excellent understanding of financial statements analysis with the ability to work through key assumptions, implicit caveats and limitations
* Excellent attention to detail, strong work ethic, and ability to manage multiple ongoing assignments efficiently and accurately
* Familiarity with relevant accounting standards and policies produced and amended from time to time by the AICPA and other oversight bodies
* Knowledge of software packages including MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Direct experience working with VBA, Python, and Power BI is highly desirable
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills that help represent diverse communities
* Experience working with diverse teams

**About Kroll**

Join the global leader in risk and financial advisory solutions—Kroll. With a nearly century\-long legacy, we blend trusted expertise with cutting\-edge technology to navigate and redefine industry complexities. As a part of One Team, One Kroll, you'll contribute to a collaborative and empowering environment, propelling your career to new heights. Ready to build, protect, restore and maximize our clients’ value? Your journey begins with Kroll.
